format.rev: NSE commodity transaction charges, ₹ Cr [at today's rates, at the rule then in force]
format.ru: transaction revenue per underlying, ₹ Cr at today's rates: {nse, mcx}; NSE's priced from fee_register, MCX's = its reported futures / options revenue for the day split by each underlying's share of futures notional / options premium; in periods, summed over ru_days
format.xo: underlyings with an NSE options contract expiring that day (bhavcopy XpryDt = TradDt); absent on days read before parser 2
format.prem_days: in periods: the sessions whose options premium is summed; a day whose MCX file gives every option a premium of 0 (2026-06-23) adds no premium on either side

source.premium: NSE options premium = TtlTrfVal − strike × multiplier × lots (derived; matched NSE's market turnover summary to the rupee on 17 Nov 2026)
